name: comp-483

frames.best_why: Table and full pagination bar together: size picker, 1-5 of 60 count and four page buttons.

tagline: Account table paged five at a time with a rows-per-page picker.
summary: A dark account table inside a rounded border, with sortable headers, row checkboxes and a footer bar. That bar holds a rows-per-page menu, a live count like 1-5 of 60, and first, previous, next and last buttons.
appearance: A black table in a thin rounded frame: a checkbox column, bold names, emails, flag emojis with cities, rounded status pills and right-aligned balances. Under it, a grey control row pairs a small dropdown, a page counter and four outlined square chevron buttons.
behaviour: Clicking a header sorts and shows an up or down arrow. The page buttons step through the rows and grey out at the ends; the size menu swaps the table between 5, 10, 25 and 50 rows, and the counter follows.
demo_content: Duplicate employee records with flags, status pills and balances; sixty rows in all.
search_phrases: table with page numbers and arrows
change how many rows show per page
sortable table with next and last buttons
rows per page dropdown under a table
table with first previous next last controls
use_when: A long account list needs paging with a visible count and a choice of rows per page.
avoid_when: The demo loads the fetched users twice, so every person appears in duplicate until you supply real data.
customise: Page sizes, column widths and the fetch URL are written in the file; supplying different records or another default sort means editing the source.
weight_why: A table library paginates and sorts sixty remote rows; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Page buttons carry labels, the counter is announced politely and the size menu has a real label, but sorted headers never set aria-sort.

issues: The demo appends the same user list to itself, so every person appears twice.
In the larger-page frames the pagination bar is pushed below the crop.
Sortable headers show a chevron but expose no aria-sort attribute.
polish_why: Complete pagination bar with labels, counts and sizing; duplicated demo data is the one blemish.
title: Paginated Sortable Table
